Title: Generally available: Managed Identities support for Capture in Event Hubs

Body.Content: With the general availability of Managed Identities support for Capture feature in Azure Event Hubs, users now can use managed identities when capturing event streams to storage services such as Azure Storage Services or Azure Data Lake storage 2. This also enables users to do cross subscription data capturing.
